floorPlans.label: Nshama Rosewell official apartment plans
floorPlans.introduction: Compare the published one-, two- and three-bedroom apartment layouts.
floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Ranges follow the printed minimum and maximum figures. Types C and D appear in Nshama’s earlier plan document. Their current applicability is unconfirmed. Confirm the area for the specific apartment.

review.gallery: 7 project renders from Nshama’s live project gallery. The two June 26, 2026 photos in project 4149 have identical source hashes in the Evelyn project 4150 album. The selected original is labeled as a shared site view. The exact plot boundary is unconfirmed. Inspection index https://dubaihandover.com/projects/4149-rosewell.
review.location: The project is marked on brochure physical page 8. The master-plan panel is shown separately from the community figures below it. The project-specific DLD point from Dubai Handover agrees with that part of the community. Nearby times are from physical page 6 and apply to Town Square.
review.floorPlans: Five currently linked developer sheets plus two differently shaped two-bedroom Types C and D from the earlier original, pages 5 and 6. The later five-family set takes precedence for the overlapping types. All selected printed built-up totals were visually checked. Minor rounding differences in displayed suite and balcony components are retained through the published total.

unavailable: Confirmed visitor entrance, completed-building photography and a complete duplex drawing set. Current applicability of the earlier Type C and D plans.
